title: Software Engineer - BYG
original_description:
Software Engineer - Customer Operations Platform

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a software engineer

iwoca’s operational tools and processes are a competitive advantage, allowing us to give great customer service, manage risk, and get money into our customers’ hands as quickly as possible.

You’ll join our growing Customer Operations Platform team to help improve the systems that power these processes, building tailored flows for our Operations teams, automating processes using AI, using ML models to make smarter decisions, and improving the reliability of our communication services.

You’ll work closely with our Operations teams, getting user feedback and input on requirements from users working in the same building, and seeing the impact of your changes on the people you work with.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The role

As an engineer you’d take whole projects end to end, work out what' s actually needed, design it, build it and look after it in production.

Responsibility and Autonomy:

  • Take on complex projects that span many systems and many stakeholders — e.g. CRM, telephony, contact, and task management

  • Build a strong understanding of the business context: how our ops teams actually work, how the processes you're automating are supposed to run, and what the people relying on your systems need from them.

  • Do the detailed technical scoping and prototyping that tells us whether an idea is feasible before it reaches the roadmap.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Take on complex coding and architecture problems with a high level of ambiguity and technical complexity.

  • Write fluent technical documents and developer tickets distilling product requirements into clear and actionable technical work.

  • Build relationships with key stakeholders including Operations Strategy, Credit Analysts, Account Managers, and Collections teams.

Learning and Growth:

  • Embody our growth mindset mentality by sharing new technologies and best practices within the team as well as more broadly across the company.

The projects

Here are some of the most recent problems we are solving:

  • iwocaChat. Operations staff spend a large share of their day assembling context from multiple systems before they can help a customer. iwocaChat uses Claude to answer those questions directly, so staff spend their time on the customer rather than the lookup.

  • Migrating the monolith. We are incrementally moving business logic out of our Django monolith into smaller, independently deployable services. Because it cuts across every domain, you'd be shaping service boundaries and ownership models that stick around long after the monolith is gone.

  • Inbox messaging reworking. We are replacing our third party email inbox application with an inhouse solution, utilising AI to enable operations staff to automate the actions of our most frequent customer service enquiries.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience developing and owning shared back end services that other engineering teams contribute to and depend on - being the trusted reviewer for their contributions and shaping how they build on top of your work.

  • Familiarity with front-end technologies (React, TypeScript) and browser debugging.

  • Experience building and shaping distributed systems in complex business domains.

  • Ability to translate complex operational needs into technical architecture.

  • Strong capability using AI tools to automate routine tasks and research, enabling greater focus on complex system architecture and critical technical decision-making.

Bonus:

  • Commercial experience with Python frameworks like Django.

  • Experience with complex data architectures, including event-sourced data models.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 - £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a brilliant place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Frankfurt, and Berlin with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and clubs, like bingo, comedy nights, yoga classes, football, etc.

The benefits

  • Flexible working.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year, we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

  • See iwoca benefits & policies for detail and some additional benefits.

  • See interview welcome pack to learn more about the process.

Compensation: £70K – £90K

title: Senior Software Engineer (Multiple Teams, Europe)
original_description:
As a Senior Software Engineer on Coder’s Engineering team, you’ll build and evolve the systems behind our agentic development experience. You’ll work across the agent harness, integrations, and workflows that connect agents with real development environments.

You’ll stay hands-on, solve complex technical problems, and work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to ship reliable agentic experiences.

What you’ll do here

  • Design and build production systems in Go, with work across React and TypeScript where needed.

  • Improve agent execution, tool use, context management, streaming, and long-running workflows.

  • Extend our provider-agnostic architecture as models and capabilities change.

  • Build reliable integrations between agents, workspaces, tools, and developer infrastructure.

  • Own projects from implementation through rollout and iteration.

  • Contribute to design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions.

  • Partner with Product and Design to turn agent capabilities into useful developer experiences.

  • Improve the reliability, performance, and operability of agentic systems.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong experience building and operating production software systems.

  • Hands-on experience with Go.

  • Experience with React and TypeScript.

  • Experience building systems around LLMs or agentic workflows.

  • Familiarity with model APIs, tool calling, context management, or agent loops.

  • Good understanding of distributed systems and production reliability.

  • Working knowledge of AWS.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working through technical ambiguity.

  • Someone who contributes beyond their own code through reviews, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

Bonus tacos if you have

  • Experience building coding agents, developer tools, or cloud development environments.

  • Experience with MCP, agent tools, or multi-agent systems.

  • Experience with remote execution, sandboxing, or isolated compute.

  • Experience building integrations across multiple model providers.

  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, or Linux.

  • Open-source contributions or experience working directly with customers.

Our tech stack

  • Backend: Go, Postgres

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

Coder’s agentic architecture is provider-agnostic. The foundation is built; this role helps extend it, improve it, and ship the next set of agentic capabilities.

About Coder

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview process 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

Our use of AI in hiring

We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:

  • Ashby helps us review inbound applications by surfacing candidates who best match the role requirements we've defined. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first.

  • Granola takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

In accordance with New York City Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on "Automated Employment Decision Tools"; results are available for Ashby.

If you're applying for a role at Coder and have questions about how we use AI in our process, or if you'd like to request information about the data we collect, please contact  

Coder is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Software Engineer (Backend) - London
original_description:
About Us

Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations gets older and a shortage in staff, healthcare system is under pressure. Our missions is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.

Our product enables careteams to intervene, prevent and operator more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms captures activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signal used for both react fast to risk events, like falls, and long term health analysis, for care teams to take actions.

Teton is scaling fast, operating in Nordics, UK, DACH and US. Recently raised 20M $$ series A. Expect travel to the US, to meet users and team members.

We focus relentless on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for cares. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, striving to always raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you.

If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard working, high agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.

The Job

We are looking for a strong backend engineer to help scale the core infrastructure powering Teton’s platform.

Our systems ingest and process continuous streams of real-time data from thousands of deployed edge devices across care facilities. These systems power critical alerts and operational workflows used by healthcare staff around the clock.

You will work across:

  • Distributed data ingestion systems

  • Real-time event pipelines

  • APIs and backend services

  • Databases and storage systems

  • MQTT infrastructure and edge communication

  • Reliability, observability, and system performance

  • Cloud infrastructure and deployment architecture

Qualifications:

We care more about engineering ability and ownership than specific credentials, but strong candidates will likely have experience with several of the following:

  • Building and operating large-scale backend or distributed systems

  • Designing reliable real-time data pipelines

  • Working with event-driven architectures and asynchronous systems

  • Scaling APIs and services handling high-throughput workloads

  • Operating production infrastructure with strong reliability requirements

  • Database design and performance optimization

  • Cloud infrastructure and deployment tooling

  • Debugging complex production issues under pressure

What We Offer

  • Participation in our warrant program (stock options).

  • A small team where your decisions directly shape the product.

  • A Copenhagen-based office with close collaboration, no async-only culture.

  • Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day, the impact is tangible and immediate.

Join Our Team

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job.

At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work.

If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
original_description:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.


About the role

Our Engineering team tackles the toughest challenges, so our users never have to. Real-time infrastructure, AI-native architecture, and a frontend that feels effortless - all powered by a team that moves fast, thinks rigorously, and holds an exceptionally high bar for quality.

We're looking for Platform Engineers who treat the platform as a product, with every engineer at Attio as its customer. You'll own the infrastructure, tooling and pipelines that let the rest of engineering ship quickly and safely, and you'll be accountable for keeping all of it reliable, fast and cost-effective as we scale.

What you'll do

  • Build and evolve our platform infrastructure as code (Terraform, Kubernetes, GCP), so every environment is reproducible, version-controlled and auditable.

  • Own our CI/CD pipelines end-to-end, making builds, tests and deploys fast, reliable and secure for every engineer at Attio.

  • Own our observability stack - metrics, logging and distributed tracing - as the foundation of an exceptional reliability culture.

  • Define and hold SLOs for latency, availability and error rates, and manage capacity to stay comfortably inside them.

  • Lead incident response: triage and resolve complex production issues, then run blameless post-mortems and ship the fixes as code.

  • Partner with product engineering teams to remove manual toil and shorten the path from writing code to running it in production.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on experience operating production systems with an SRE mindset: SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction and blameless post-mortems.

  • Excellent knowledge of modern cloud architectures (either GCP or AWS), including networking, IAM and managed services.

  • Demonstrable deep expertise with Docker and Kubernetes at scale, covering cluster design, networking, storage and security.

  • Proficiency in a modern language such as Typescript, Go, Python or Rust, and a track record of writing well-tested automation.

  • Experience owning mission-critical operational tooling, including centralised logging or APM (e.g. Datadog, Splunk).

  • Ability to communicate technical ideas to the wider team and influence how other engineers build and operate their services.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary of £105,000 to £125,000

  • Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory

  • 25 days holiday plus local public holidays

  • Apple hardware

  • Private medical insurance through AXA

  • Pension contribution through Hargreaves Lansdown

  • Enhanced family leave

  • Team off-site in fun places! (We've been to Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

Compensation: £105K – £125K • Offers Equity

  • E3 • Target starting bands, there may be room outside of these decided on a case by case basis £105K – £125K • Offers Equity

title: Software Engineer (Product) - London
original_description:
About Us

Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations get older and staff shortages grow, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.

Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis that care teams can act on.

Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, UK, DACH and US. We raised a $20M Series A. Expect travel to the US to meet users and team members.

We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you.

If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.

The Job

We're looking for a talented and driven Product Engineer to own customer-facing features from the first conversation with a care team to the feature running in production. Care workers rely on our product during every shift and care managers use it to follow up on their residents, on mobile and on the web. This isn't a ticket-taking role. You'll talk to users, cut scope, build across the whole stack, and check afterwards whether what you shipped actually made a shift easier. Your goal is to shrink the time from a customer request to a deployed solution, without cutting corners on reliability or on the privacy of residents' health data.

In this role, you will focus on:

  • Feature Development: Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages, on the web app, the mobile app and the APIs behind them.

  • Customer Insight: Talk to care staff and our customer success team every week, visit care facilities, and turn what you hear into clearly scoped product changes. Come with ideas, sketch the solution, and push it forward.

  • Fast Iteration: Break large designs and features into small shippable pieces. Get MVPs in front of users quickly, measure how they're used, and iterate or kill them.

  • Backend & APIs: Design and build the APIs, data models and services your features need. You will not just consume APIs, you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them.

  • Quality, Privacy & Safety: Ship with care for health data: sensible access control, auditability and privacy by default. Build test coverage and use staged rollouts so new features never get in the way of the alerts care teams depend on.

Qualifications

  • Strong TypeScript skills: this is the language for everything we build.

  • Solid production experience with React on the web and/or React Native.

  • Comfortable working across the stack: you've built backend APIs and worked with relational databases (e.g. Postgres), not just UI.

  • Great product taste and a keen eye for UX. You work well with designers and can make sensible design decisions yourself when needed.

  • Comfortable talking directly with non-technical users and turning messy feedback into concrete decisions.

  • Previous startup experience and/or shipping a product where you owned the outcome, from idea to adoption.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with React Native and Expo in production.

  • AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience.

  • Familiarity with TanStack, real-time systems or push notifications.

  • Experience with health data or other regulated, privacy-sensitive domains (e.g. GDPR).

  • Experience shipping products across multiple markets and languages.

What We Offer

  • Participation in our warrant program (stock options).

  • A small team where your decisions directly shape the product.

  • Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day, the impact is tangible and immediate.

Join Our Team

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job.

At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work.

If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

title: Research Scientist / Research Engineer, Automated Safety
cleaned_description: p strong Your Impact at LILA /strong /p p We re building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems. /p p As scientific AI systems become more capable and autonomous, their safety assessment and safeguards must develop alongside them. At Lila Sciences, you will help build the research methods and tools that make this possible, so that more and more decision-enablers can be automated safely. This will move us closer to the vision of a safety and security apparatus that is robust to a fully autonomous scientific engine. /p p Your initial focus will be misuse: developing flexible and automated red-teaming approaches that test safety-relevant scientific capabilities and the robustness of safeguards. You will also contribute to safety automation beyond red teaming, helping the team evaluate, monitor and respond to risks across increasingly autonomous scientific workflows. You will own reusable research methods and assessment tools, working with mitigation engineers who implement protective mechanisms. We welcome Research Scientists and Research Engineers; responsibilities can span or evolve between the two profiles. /p p strong What You ll Be Building /strong /p ul li Develop and run capability evaluations of scientific models, agents and tool-mediated workflows (including simulated lab environments), working with domain experts to make tests scientifically meaningful. /li li Create methods or systems that explore diverse failure modes, adapt tests as evidence emerges and support systematic investigation beyond fixed benchmarks. /li li Build reproducible experiments and evaluation tools that capture relevant behavior, outcomes and the evidence needed to interpret findings. /li li Measure the quality and coverage of automated assessments, including failure cases in the evaluators themselves. /li li Develop broader safety automation, across threat model management, evidence triage, regression testing, monitoring workflows or tools that help researchers assess and respond to risks. /li li Collaborate with risk researchers and mitigation engineers to translate findings into improved assessments and safeguards, and verify whether those changes work. /li /ul p strong What You ll Need to Succeed /strong /p ul li Strong empirical judgment, practical programming ability and experience working with modern AI systems. /li li The ability to investigate ambiguous failures, design informative comparisons and communicate limitations clearly. /li li An interest in scientific misuse risks and the ability to collaborate productively with domain specialists. /li li strong For the Research Scientist profile: /strong evidence of selecting valuable research questions, developing or adapting methods, and designing experiments that yield defensible conclusions. You should be able to prototype and test your ideas. /li li strong For the Research Engineer profile: /strong evidence of building reliable research software, evaluation infrastructure or agent systems that enable reproducible experiments and efficient iteration. You should be able to contribute to experimental design and interpretation. /li /ul p strong Bonus Points For /strong /p ul li Automated red teaming, adversarial testing or evaluation-method research. /li li Scientific AI, tool-using agents, laboratory automation or other complex environments. /li li Experience with safety monitoring, model-based evaluators or scalable experimental infrastructure. /li /ul div class= content-pay-transparency div class= pay-input div class= description p strong Compensation /strong /p p We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact. /p p strong U.S. Benefits. /strong Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program. /p p strong International Benefits. /strong Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market. /p /div div class= title Expected Base Salary Range /div div class= pay-range span $180,000 /span span class= divider mdash; /span span $298,000 USD /span /div /div /div div class= content-conclusion p strong About LILA /strong /p p Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind s greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves. /p p LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai. /p p Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you d love to work in, even if you don t meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply. /p p strong We’re All In /strong /p p Lila Sciences is nbsp;committed to equal employment opportunity nbsp;regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. /p p Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our a href= https://www.lila.ai/candidate-privacy-policy-notice Candidate Privacy Policy /a . /p p strong A Note to Agencies /strong /p p em Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. /span /li /ul p nbsp; /p h6 #LI-ST1 /h6 p nbsp; /p div class= content-conclusion h3 strong span style= font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; What s Roku s approach to hybrid working? /span /strong /h3 p Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days a week attendance. /p p nbsp; /p h3 style= font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; strong What are some of the benefits? /strong /h3 p Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It s important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. /p p nbsp; /p h3 style= font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; strong Accommodations /strong /h3 p Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to a ---------- p nbsp; /p h3 style= font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; strong What should I know about Roku s culture? /strong /h3 p Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company s success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We re independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you ll be part of a company that s changing how the world watches TV. /p p We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn t real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. /p p To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we ve grown, visit a href= https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet /a . /p p By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku s a href= https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants Applicant Privacy Notice /a , and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. title: Data Scientist - Broker Terms
original_description:
Data Scientist - Broker Terms Team

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Broker Terms team.

You'll shape the analytical approach for a team that sets the terms on iwoca's biggest acquisition channel. The team is young, with many unexplored opportunities.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they ildrive.

The team

Broker Terms is a growing team that sits within iwoca's third-party acquisition department. It owns the full offer terms strategy for customers referred through the broker network – both first-time customers and repeat. The team sets pricing, loan amounts, durations, and broker commissions, and owns the UX that presents them to brokers and customers.

The team is small and interdisciplinary, combining commercial strategy, engineering, and data science. The work translates business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into actionable decisions. Active projects include:

  • Model-based pricing – creating a sophisticated model to offer bespoke pricing to each customer

  • A no-fee test – examining how our product performs when we remove all drawdown fees, and how that influence customer repayment behaviour

  • Testing longer-duration flexi-loan products with particular customer segments.

  • Reintroductions - exploring the right offer terms to give returning customers

The team is small and cross-functional – commercial strategy, engineering, design, and data science – and works across the full application stack, from the Broker API to the Introducer Portal brokers use.

The role

You'll model expected customer take-up rates, design experiments, and translate findings into pricing and product decisions for the acquisition channel that drives the most customer lifetime value (CLTV). Because the Broker Terms team is a young team, you'll influence how its analytical approach develops, not just what it produces.

The work has direct commercial consequences: brokers act on what the team builds and tests, and that shapes which customers iwoca wins and on what terms.

  • Offer terms and experimentation. You'll model how customers respond to offer terms and how brokers make decisions under uncertainty. You'll design experiments where causal inference is central: you'll need to know where standard A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead.

  • Commercial translation. You'll work with commercial and strategy colleagues and see your analysis applied directly in day-to-day decisions. That includes meeting brokers in person – gaining context that shapes how you frame and interpret results – and coordinating with adjacent teams responsible for underwriting decisions, repeat lending, and offer construction.

  • CLTV and customer journey. You'll think across the full broker-referred customer journey – from first funding to repeat – identifying what drives CLTV and what changes to offer terms or UX improve it. You own both the strategy and the mechanism, so your findings feed directly into what the team builds and tests.

  • AI and ways of working. You'll use AI to accelerate and automate your analytical work – not occasionally, but as a default. You should have a view on where it genuinely helps and where a different approach is better.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, or statistics. You're comfortable with Bayesian reasoning, and have applied hierarchical models or formal decision-making under uncertainty in real work.

  • Causal inference and experimentation. You've separated signal from noise in observational and experimental data. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. You have experience with careful experimental design to facilitate clean, trustworthy results.

  • Analytical ownership. You take loosely defined problems from start to finish – framing the question, choosing the method, and landing the answer with the people who act on it.

  • Data tooling. You're proficient with data manipulation and modelling tools, and with scientific computing libraries (pandas, numpy, sklearn, PyMC).

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles.

Bonus:

  • Modelling depth. You've built or adapted statistical or ML models and can explain the maths behind them to commercial stakeholders.

  • Stochastic methods. You've used stochastic processes for inference or time-series modelling.

  • Broker market insight. You've worked with brokers or other intermediaries in lending or financial services.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation: £70K – £80K

Data Scientist - Third Party Acquisition (3PA) - DE

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist

You'll design experiments and build models that shape how iwoca grows through brokers and partners in Germany. You'll set the approach and see your work open up finance for thousands of small businesses.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Third-Party Acquisition (3PA) Germany brings small businesses to iwoca through brokers and partners, and owns both journeys end to end – from an application arriving to a business taking up its offer.

The team works across two channels:

  • Brokers. Working with finance advisers who apply to iwoca on behalf of their clients.

  • Partners. Working with platforms, such as digital banks and accounting software, that offer iwoca lending to their own customers.

The team will be nine people across commercial strategy, analytics, product, and engineering.

The role

As the Data Scientist in 3PA Germany, you'll work out what the data says about both channels. Experiment design and statistical modelling on tabular data take up most of your time, with some machine learning. You'll turn what you find into recommendations, and work through them with the team's commercial and product colleagues.

You'll decide which questions are worth answering first, and how to answer them. You'll influence which businesses the team reaches, how they convert, and on what terms.

You'll join the analytics guild – iwoca's data science community – and share methods with data scientists in the UK broker and partner teams, who work on similar questions.

Live project examples:

  • Funnel experiments. Designing and analysing controlled experiments across the broker and partner funnels, including where clean randomisation is hard.

  • Pre-qualification. Developing the model that shows partner customers what they could borrow before they apply.

  • Take-up and lifetime value. Modelling what makes a business take up an offer, and what raises its lifetime value.

  • Competitive position. Working out why businesses that come through brokers and partners choose iwoca over other lenders, and testing changes to the journey that win more of them.

  • Offer terms. Exploring how our lending product terms affect conversion in the broker channel, and using the results to inform product and risk decisions

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, or statistics.

  • Causal inference and experimentation. You've designed and analysed experiments, and estimated causal effects from observational data. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead.

  • Commercial judgement. You understand the business behind each question, and turn data into recommendations people act on.

  • Analytical ownership. You take loosely defined problems from start to finish – framing the question, choosing the approach, and seeing it through to a decision.

  • Coding for analysis. You write code to explore and model data. The team works in Python, and R is fine to start with.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and product roles.

Bonus:

  • Bayesian methods. You understand Bayesian statistics, and you've applied hierarchical models or are keen to.

  • Machine learning. You've built or adapted ML models, and you're curious about the maths behind them.

  • Lending knowledge. You know how lenders price loans or assess credit risk.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

title: Data Scientist - Credit Cards
original_description:
Data Scientist - Credit Cards

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Credit Cards team.

You'll build the credit risk, pricing, and customer lifetime value models behind iwoca's business credit card – who gets a card, with what features, and at what rate.

 

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca launched its business credit card at the start of 2026. It gives small businesses a fast, flexible way to pay for what they need and control their cash flow, alongside iwoca's loans. The card is a core part of iwoca's long-term growth.

The Credit Cards team builds the card on iwoca's existing lending infrastructure and customer base. The team is made up of commercial strategy product, engineering, operations, and a data scientists.

The role

As a Data Scientist in Credit Cards, you'll do the analysis and modelling for the card's commercial decisions. You'll often have small samples and incomplete data, which suits Bayesian methods. You'll quantify the uncertainty in each estimate and explain what it means for the decision.

You'll run your own projects, from framing the question with the commercial lead to helping the team act on the result. Your models will shape how the card grows. You will be embedded in a broader Credit Cards Team and learn about the product and customer needs. You'll share methods with Credit Risk Modelling, especially where card and lending models overlap, and with data scientists across iwoca in the analytics guild.

Live project examples:

  • Credit limits. Setting initial limits that balance risk with what each customer needs, and designing a framework that adjusts them as spending and repayment data comes in.

  • Pricing. Modelling how interest and fees affect take-up and spending,, to find pricing that works for iwoca and its customers.

  • Customer lifetime value. Estimating activation, spending, and retention from early signals, and updating the estimates as each cohort matures.

  • Card and loan together. Measuring cross-sell and combined credit exposure for businesses that hold both the card and an iwoca loan. Designing the mechanisms to optimise how the two products interact.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Bayesian reasoning. You've used priors, updating, and hierarchical models in real work. You know when a Bayesian model is worth the extra complexity, and when something simpler will do.

  • Analytical ownership. You've taken loosely defined problems from framing the question to a decision the business acted on.

  • Business curiosity. You've used what you learnt about a business's customers and economics to shape your analysis.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a prototype, an automation, or a modelling pipeline others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles.

Bonus:

  • Lending experience. You've worked on credit risk, pricing, or customer lifetime value in lending or financial services.

  • Small-sample modelling. You've worked with scarce data and made principled choices about regularisation or sequential updating.

  • Production machine learning. You've taken models from exploration through to deployment and monitoring.

  • Coding in Python. The team works in Python and you’ll write analyses and code in that language.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack


Compensation: £80K – £100K

  • • £80K – £100K

title: Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer
original_description:
What we are building

Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.

Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Our team

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Our approach to engineering

  • We prioritize customer needs first

  • We work in small, project-based teams

  • We have flexibility in terms of the problems we work on

  • We own the full lifecycle of our projects

  • We avoid silos and encourage taking up tasks in new areas

  • We balance quality and velocity

  • We have a shared responsibility for our production code

  • We each set our own routine to maximize our productivity

 

Your mission

 

You’ll join us as a Machine Learning Engineer/ Data Scientist for Mimica’s Data Intelligence team, whose goal is to transform raw recorded data into clean, structured, anonymized data that powers the work of other teams.

You’ll own key parts of our ML pipelines end to end, making them more accurate, cost-efficient, and trustworthy. Along the way, you’ll build evaluations and LLM judges, run experiments, and transform promising results into validated production improvements.

Your work will be applied and LLM-heavy, with opportunities to evaluate and fine-tune open-source models and build smaller, task-specific models.

If you enjoy taking ML beyond experiments, this is your chance to shape the systems at the heart of Mimica’s products and see your work deliver value to real users at scale.

 

Part of your day-to-day

 

  • Own, debug, and improve production pipelines for accuracy and efficiency.

  • Design, build, and iterate on LLM evals and LLM-as-a-judge systems, including the datasets, metrics, and benchmarks to monitor quality.

  • Run rigorous experiments on prompts, pipeline design, model choice, and inputs (e.g., OCR text vs. image + OCR), and turn the results into clear recommendations.

  • Drive LLM efficiency improvements across our pipelines by comparing models, restructuring steps, and replacing LLM calls with smaller, purpose-built models where it makes sense.

  • Expand our anonymization pipeline, including evaluating and adapting existing models.

  • Work with Python and quality engineers to take experiments into production, and share responsibility for the code you ship.

  • Document findings in writing (eg. experiment reports, design docs)

 

What we’re looking for

 

Primarily, we’re looking for an individual with an experiment- and data-driven researcher mindset with good coding habits. This includes:

  • Solid machine learning/data science background: you understand experimental design, data splits, metrics, bias, and statistical significance, and you know when a result is real.

  • Hands-on experience applying LLMs in production or near-production settings, especially evaluating them: building eval sets, LLM judges and benchmarks, and iterating on prompts and pipelines against them.

  • Comfortable getting deep into messy data: exploring it, troubleshooting issues, and transforming insights into measurable improvements.

  • Strong Python and good engineering skills. You write clear, readable, tested code that others can take to production, even if you’re not the one owning the infrastructure.

  • Able to work independently on ambiguous problems: framing the question, choosing the approach, and deciding on the acceptance criteria to ship.

  • Use AI coding tools effectively and stay accountable for the output: understand, explain, and defend everything you ship.

  • Communicate clearly in spoken and written English, including explaining technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

 

Bonus / Nice to have

  • Experience with classical ML or deep learning model development.

  • Experience with image/OCR pipelines or face-related anonymization

  • Experience shipping end-to-end ML features in a startup or scale-up environment.

 

Location

This is a fully remote position. To make sure we work well together, we’re only considering candidates based in the UK or Europe, in time zones compatible with London (typically UTC-1 to UTC+3).

 

Hiring Process

  • Stage 1. Talent Partner (30-45 min)

  • Stage 2. Take-home challenge (flexible) + Technical Discussion with the team (1h)

  • Stage 3. Technical design exercise and situational questions in session w/ two ML Engineers (1h)

  • Stage 4. Behavioral interview w/ Engineering leadership (1h)

  • Offer

  • Identity Verification

What we offer

💰 Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills.

🏢 Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix.

💻 Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget

📍 Flexible schedules and location

☀️ Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays

🍼 Enhanced parental leave

🧘‍♀️ Health & retirement benefits

📖 Annual learning & development budget

🌴 Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials

🌍 Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work

Note: Some benefits may vary depending on location and role

⚠️ Mimica will only contact candidates from an ----- email address. We do not request banking or sensitive personal information during the recruiting process.

title: Software Engineer, Privacy Engineering (Lawful Access)
original_description:
About the Team

The Privacy Engineering team builds secure, reliable systems that help OpenAI meet its legal obligations while protecting user data. We partner closely with Legal and Engineering teams across OpenAI to support lawful data access requests and other critical legal workflows. Our work turns complex, high-stakes processes into auditable and dependable technical systems with clear human oversight and strong privacy and security controls.

About the Role

We’re looking for a full-stack Software Engineer to build the internal tools and data pipelines that power lawful data access request workflows and Legal Operations. You will work across product and data systems to make authorized retrieval and case handling accurate, efficient, and auditable. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys translating ambiguous operational requirements into durable systems, cares deeply about sensitive-data handling, and wants to improve both technical reliability and the day-to-day experience of the people operating these workflows.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with two additional locations under consideration: London, UK, and Dublin, Ireland. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate backend systems and workflow tooling for the full lifecycle of lawful data access requests, from intake and scoping through authorized retrieval, review, preparation, and audit.

  • Build reliable data pipelines and interfaces across products and data stores so authorized teams can locate and handle the right records accurately and reproducibly.

  • Implement least-privilege access, approval gates, provenance, audit trails, data minimization, and safe failure modes for sensitive workflows.

  • Partner with Legal and Legal Operations to translate legal and operational requirements into clear technical designs and intuitive operator experiences.

  • Identify responsible automation opportunities that reduce repetitive work while preserving human review, judgment, and accountability.

  • Own production systems through testing, observability, incident response, documentation, and continuous reliability improvements.

  • Help define the architecture and roadmap for reusable privacy and legal-infrastructure foundations as OpenAI’s products and obligations evolve.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience building or operating systems for lawful data access requests and understand the domain’s legal-process lifecycle, privacy and security constraints, auditability requirements, and operational sensitivities.

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience building production services or data-intensive systems.

  • Ability to reason carefully about correctness, authorization, security, and privacy when working with sensitive data.

  • A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into pragmatic plans and communicating technical tradeoffs clearly.

  • End-to-end ownership, including operating what you build, and comfort learning unfamiliar products and domains.

  • Care for operator experience and a drive to make complex workflows safer, clearer, and more efficient.

  • Experience collaborating across Engineering, Legal, operations, Privacy, and Security stakeholders.

About OpenAI

title: Manager, AI Engineering
original_description:
About SandboxAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

The Opportunity

The SandboxAQ AI team is looking for a hands-on Manager, AI Engineering to help us build the future of agentic collaboration, trust and ROI. Our goal is to make agents work well on their own, in teams, and with humans. This includes the following aspects:

  • Security: Discovery of agents, evaluation, red teaming, monitoring, guardrails, etc.

  • Quality: Measuring ROI of agents and suggesting improvements

  • Collaboration: Bringing humans and agents together into one place with shared context

A successful candidate thrives at the intersection of AI and software engineering. You deeply understand how models and agents work, how they can fail, how they can be protected and improved. You have hands-on experience with agents in production, know what works and what doesn’t, know the latest trends and you’re opinionated about the future. You know what you don’t know and enjoy learning to close those gaps. You’ll turn your insights and innovation into real world features baked into our platform - shipping code to production.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll break things, fix them and then harden them for good while also leading a small team of engineers. At the same time, you’ll have freedom to explore, collaborate, publish, and deploy, shaping the field of agentic collaboration and trust from all angles. You will help set technical direction, raise the quality bar, mentor team members, and ensure that the team moves quickly from research insight to real-world product impact.

We’re looking for somebody with the curiosity of a researcher, the rigor of an engineer, and the creativity of a hacker. You will be part of a diverse team consisting of ML experts, security experts, mathematicians, and software engineers, each playing a key role in efficient and effective enablement of the cutting-edge technologies being developed at SandboxAQ.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a small, highly technical team while remaining deeply involved in hands-on engineering and research.

  • Set technical direction, break down ambiguous problems, establish practical plans for fast, high-quality execution, and build a culture of ownership, low-ego collaboration, thoughtful experimentation, and high standards.

  • Create new agentic capabilities, including frameworks for monitoring, guardrailing, and evaluating agents, while staying current on the latest agentic developments and identifying new opportunities.

  • Perform classical ML tasks, including exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and model fine-tuning, and rapidly iterate on prototypes and features based on feedback and evolving product needs.

  • Work closely with Product and Research to translate AI research into applicable features and software engineering projects.

  • Contribute production-ready code and technical designs, working across engineering to deliver scalable, reliable software.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • BSc in Computer Science or related field with exposure to AI/ML.

  • Deep expertise in AI/ML, software engineering, or AI security.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, and relevant ML and/or agentic frameworks.

  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with a high degree of end-to-end ownership, delivering real world outcomes.

  • Ability to pick up other programming languages and technologies as required to ship scalable and reliable software.

Highly Desired Skills & Experience

  • PhD in Computer Science or related field with focus on AI/ML or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: agent orchestration, agent harnesses, agent teams, jailbreaking / prompt injection, red teaming, data poisoning or evasion attacks, secure model deployment or sandboxing, detection and monitoring for AI misuse.

  • Experience contributing to open source projects.

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Experience in cybersecurity is a plus, but not essential.

Why Join Us?

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work.

  • Career Defining Work: Your work will directly accelerate the discovery of better drugs and better materials, advance human health, and enable safer and more sustainable technologies by helping customers put AI Simulation capabilities into real world use.

  • Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.

  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits.

  • Work-Life Balance: Fully remote, Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance.

  • Learning and Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning and growth through on-the-job development, cross-functional collaboration, and access to internal learning and development programs.

SandboxAQ Welcomes All

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges.

Equal Employment Opportunity: All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.

Accommodations: We provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in job application procedures for open roles. If you need such an accommodation, please let a member of our Recruiting team know.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
location: Addlestone, Richmond upon Thames, United Kingdom
original_description:
Join an established technology organisation providing managed IT services to some of the market's most recognised companies. Our client is looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to support customer environments across a varied and hands-on technical role.

The successful candidate will combine remote support with regular customer-site activity, working across infrastructure, Microsoft technologies, hardware, software and security.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide technical assistance to customers and act as a reliable point of contact.

  • Attend customer locations to diagnose faults, carry out repairs and complete scheduled maintenance.

  • Manage support incidents and requests through the company's ticketing system.

  • Provide customers with timely updates and ensure agreed service levels are maintained.

  • Escalate critical technical problems to Management when appropriate.

  • Review workload and priorities each day and take ownership of required actions.

  • Monitor customer infrastructure and system environments to ensure they remain operational and meet business requirements.

  • Deploy, test, maintain and troubleshoot hardware and software.

  • Accurately document technical work and maintain up-to-date service tickets.

  • Take ownership of urgent incidents, whether handled remotely or at a customer site.

Benefits

  • £30,000 - £40,000 per annum depending on experience.

  • 40 days' paid holiday annually.


You will need at least 5 years' experience in a relevant IT role, with a strong technical background covering:

  • Cyber Essentials and GDPR security implementation (mandatory).

  • Microsoft 365 and its core services, including Email, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive (mandatory).

  • Intune, RMM platforms and telephone/communications systems.

  • Network infrastructure and connectivity, including routers, switches, APs, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, VLANs and firewalls.

  • Working collaboratively with external suppliers and technical service providers.

  • IT processes, procedures and industry best practices.

  • Windows Server 2016, 2019 and 2022, including Group Policy and security configuration.

  • Azure administration and system implementations.

  • Windows 10, Windows 11 and Mac.

  • Client builds, imaging and deployment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with a strong customer-service mindset.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills and the ability to work independently.
